name: app-vehicle-selection-label-strip-with-caption-on-white
title: Rounded white strip with an outlined 'Vehicle selection' pill and a caption on contrast by intent
whatItIs: A slim white panel with rounded top corners on black, an outlined pill 'VEHICLE SELECTION' at the left and an uppercase caption at the right (some black, some grey) explaining a full-screen road hero with soft info up top and hard numbers on a dark pill.
whatItMeans: Quiet and explanatory; the caption states the design rule in one line.
techniques: Label the next screen with an outlined pill.
Explain the design intent in a caption.
Frame in black with rounded corners.

vocabulary.definition: A short line explaining a design choice.
An outlined capsule naming a section.
Deliberately pairing soft and hard elements.
A panel with softly rounded corners.
